The '''Drennic Listening Post''' was a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] used by the [[Drennics|Drennic]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:HE" />
{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Drennic Listening Post appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Drennic Listening Post was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Azure Cabal|Azure Cabal questline]],<ref name="SWG:HE" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="Chapter 6">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
